Download carousel.pdf (10.35 MB, vector text) → LinkedIn → start a post → add a document → upload the PDF → title it: Regardless of Whether, the FCC's Check on Arctic Fiber

2 · Paste the post copy

The FCC cleared GCI's Arctic fiber deal partly by citing Starlink, a rival the record can't agree sells wholesale middle mile in Alaska.

The line is 1,176 miles of subsea fiber from Prudhoe Bay to Nome.

The check is a hedge. The FCC found nothing to suggest Starlink couldn't sell wholesale service "regardless of whether" it does today.

Sea ice cut the line near Oliktok Point in January 2025. The outage ran seven to nine months by differing accounts.

The real check is on paper. Contracts over $5,000 a month per circuit go to the FCC under seal.

Pictured are the route, ACS's objection, the 2025 cut and GCI's conditions. The line ends at Prudhoe Bay, where a gas plant is pitched for AI data centers the order never mentions.

GCI's wholesale filings end seven years after closing. Will Starlink sell wholesale middle mile on that coast by then?

#AlaskaBroadband #SubseaFiber #MiddleMile

3 · Post, then paste this as the FIRST comment (within a minute)

Editor's note

Re-score after the CRAFT FLOOR cycle (rounds used: 4 of 5). The weighted total is 8.485 against the round 4 threshold of 7.7, with no hard fails, so it ships. Artwork craft rose from 7.0 to 7.5, still under the 8.5 craft floor. The one owed craft cycle has now been spent, so record score_report.craft_cycle {frames: [5, 4, 7, 3, 6, 8], art_before: 7.0, art_after: 7.5} and re-sync the storyboard GATE STATUS block, which still shows score 8.355 and ship_gate FAIL. Flag the art shortfall honestly in the email. Things the human should know before posting. (1) Three of the six round 4 repairs didn't land in the pixels: 03's stray teal arc at the top edge, 06's dark fin where the cable meets the fog, and 07's frost glints, which still look like rain dashes. 04's lower-right raster blocks behind the counter also remain. None of these affects reading, but a close zoomer will find them. (2) Slide 7 row 3 now reads 'Then only if Anchorage inflation tops 5 percent, capped at that rate, once a year', which matches C26 and C28 exactly. The first comment's stale disclaimer is gone. (3) This is the second fiber story in four runs (No.98 was AIDEA's Northstar Fiber), so the subject may feel repeated even though the event is new. (4) Post Wednesday November 4th or Thursday November 5th, not Tuesday November 3rd, which is Election Day. Reconsideration petitions run to November 19th by arithmetic, and that date isn't printed in the order. (5) The deck never says Starlink sells wholesale middle mile in Alaska. If a commenter asserts it, ask for the contract, as the aftercare advises. (6) The weakest criterion is now the arc (02, 03 and 04 are dense and dark in a row, and 04 is the likely bail point). That is a copy and layout change for a future deck, not a defect blocking this one. Aftercare (this is where reach is won)

  • Post Wednesday November 4th or Thursday November 5th, 8 to 11 a.m. Alaska time. Tuesday to Thursday 8 to 11 a.m. is normally the strongest slot, but Tuesday November 3rd is Election Day and results will crowd feeds that morning. Drafts arrive daily, and posting cadence is your call.
  • Paste the sources comment within 60 seconds of posting, with every URL as plain text so LinkedIn keeps the links.
  • Reply to every comment in the first 60 to 90 minutes and point each question to its slide (the Starlink hedge slide 2, the route and the $310 million enterprise value slide 3, ACS's objection slide 4, the 2025 cut slide 5, the cable slide 6, the conditions slide 7, Prudhoe Bay and the gas plant slide 8). If someone says Starlink already sells wholesale middle mile in Alaska, ask for the contract rather than agreeing, because the order records disagreement and finds only that nothing suggests it couldn't.
  • The reconsideration window is open. Petitions may be filed within thirty days of the October 20th release, which counts to November 19th (that date is arithmetic and isn't printed in the order). A filing in that window is a natural follow-up.
  • After 48 hours, note saves and comments for the ledger.
